block.comedymonkeysaddons.incinerator.to: A _bottomless furnace_ that _destroys_ every _item_ and _fluid_ put into it. Perfect for the overflow nobody wants.

While it is _burning_ something it _heats_ a _Steam Engine boiler_ above it like a lit _Blaze Burner_. It takes _ten things_ (an item, or a tenth of a bucket of anything, _water_ too) to get it hot. Keep feeding it at least _one a second_: stop, and it's cold within _10 seconds_.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.copper_fluid_l: A slim _pump-free_ pipe. Fluid moves only from an _Intake_, up to _100 mB a tick_, into every tank the line reaches. Nothing stays in the line.
Joins other _Copper_ Fluid Lines of the _same colour_ and any block that _holds fluid_. It never joins Brass Fluid Lines or Create's pipes.
_Dyes_ eight Fluid Lines, before they're placed. Lines of _two colours_ never join (_plain_ is a colour too), so different lines can run _side by side_. _Bulk washing_ takes the dye off.
_Encases_ the line in that block, hiding it. It keeps working; _Engineer's Goggles_ show where it runs.
Takes off its _fitting_, or _cuts_ or _joins_ the joint on the side you hit. Sneak to take the encasing off.

Joins Copper Power Lines of the same colour, and _anything_ that gives or takes power. Power flows by itself, from generators to machines. _Brass_ of the same colour feeds it where they meet on a _Line Post_, or at a _Breaker_ once that joint is _wrenched_ (the same colour); it never feeds brass.
Hangs a _span_ between their insulators, up to _16 blocks_: one Power Line for every four blocks. The way between must be clear.

_Dyes_ eight Power Lines, before they're placed: a dyed Power Line is a slightly thicker _covered cable_. Lines of _two colours_ never join (_plain_ is a colour too), so different cables can run _side by side_. _Bulk washing_ takes the dye off.

block.comedymonkeysaddons.line_post.tool: A wooden post with a ceramic _insulator_, for hanging _Power Line_ spans. Posts _stack_ into a pole of any height.
The top post is the _head_. Each insulator is its own connection; a wire running under the _foot_ joins the head's top insulator.
R-Click a head's side with a Line Post
Adds a _branch_ there, with an insulator of its own: up to four. Sneak to place a post instead.
Takes down the spans on the nearest insulator.
Clip it onto the side of a _Fluid Line_ that _faces a tank_: it _draws_ that tank's fluid into the line. It is the only part that moves fluid, so it replaces the pump.
Draws _only_ its filter fluid when one is set, or _any_ fluid when not. Only ever from _tanks_, never from water or lava in the world.
R-Click the line with a Bucket
Sets the _filter_ to that fluid. An empty hand clears it.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.valve.tooltip.s: Clips round a straight piece of _Fluid Line_. It _shuts_ on a _redstone_ signal, and its wheel _throttles_ the flow in 10% steps.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.valve.tooltip.a: Turns the wheel _shut_ a step; sneak to _open_ it.

item.comedymonkeysaddons.meter.tooltip.s: Clips round a straight piece of _Fluid Line_ or _Power Line_. Its gauge shows the _live flow_ through it, and _comparators_ read it.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.meter.tooltip.b: Shows the flow in mB or FE a tick.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.splitter.toolti: On a _Fluid Line_ it clips round a straight piece and decides how the flow is _shared_ between the ends beyond it. On a _Power Line_ it sits on a _junction_ and decides which _branches_ are served first when power is short.
On a Fluid Line: switches between _Even_, _Nearest first_ and _Round robin_; its dial shows which.
item.comedymonkeysaddons.breaker.tooltip: Clips onto a straight _Power Line_: a switch that _cuts_ the power with its lever, or with a _redstone_ signal. comedymonkeysaddons.gui.jei.info.valve: Fit it to a straight Fluid Line. Right-click to close it 10%, sneak-right-click to open it 10%; a redstone signal shuts it.
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.jei.info.filter: Fit it to a straight Fluid Line. Right-click with a bucket to set the one fluid it passes; empty-handed clears it, and an empty Filter passes anything.
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.jei.info.meter: Fit it to a straight Fluid or Power Line. Shows the flow on its dial, to goggles and Display Links, and as a comparator signal.
comedymonkeysaddons.gui.jei.info.splitte: On a Fluid Line: fit it to a straight piece, and right-click to choose how the ends beyond it share: Even, Nearest first or Round robin. comedymonkeysaddons.gui.jei.info.breaker: Fit it to a straight Power Line. Flip its lever, or give it a redstone signal, to cut the power. Wrench the joint between it and a wire of the other tier to join brass to copper (brass feeds copper).

block.comedymonkeysaddons.battery.toolti: Stores _Forge Energy_: _10,000,000 FE_, in or out at _2,048 FE_ a tick. Spare power fills it; when the generators fall short, it gives it back.
Its _connectors_ are its _sides_, _front_ and _back_. Batteries that touch there are _one bank_ with one store, and move _2,048 FE_ a tick _each_. Stacked ones don't join.

Fill a _3x3_ footprint _3 to 9 high_ and they become one _Industrial Battery_: _20,000,000 FE_ a block, wired to _Line Posts_ by cables hung from its _four insulators_. Placed on top, one Battery fills the _whole layer_.

block.comedymonkeysaddons.geothermal_con: Forms and runs a _Geothermal Turbine_: _lava_ boils _water_ to steam that turns the turbine, for _46,080 FE_ a tick, enough for _two and a half Electric Motors_ flat out.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.fluid_lines.t: Fluid Lines move fluid with no pump and no power
Only an Intake moves fluid: fit it on the side of the line that faces a tank, and it draws that tank's fluid in
The fluid slides along the slot on top as it moves. Copper carries 100 mB a tick, brass 1,000; nothing stays in the line
Right-click the line with a bucket to set the Intake's filter: then it draws only that fluid
Copper and brass never join, and nor do two colours (plain is one), so lines can run side by side. Dye lines before you place them, eight around a dye
Right-click a line with any full block to encase it. It keeps working, and Engineer's Goggles show where it runs
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.line_fittings: Fittings clip round a straight piece of line, one to a block. The wrench takes them off again
A Valve shuts on a redstone signal. Right-click to turn its wheel down a tenth at a time; sneak to open it
A Filter lets only its own fluid past: set it with a bucket. Good for sorting fluids part-way along a line
A Meter's needle shows the flow through it. Comparators read it, and goggles give the figure
On a Fluid Line, a Splitter decides how the ends beyond it share: evenly, nearest first, or one at a time in turn. Right-click to switch
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.power_lines.t: Power Lines are thin cable for FE. They lie flat on whatever floor, wall or ceiling you place them against, and fold round corners
Power flows by itself, from anything that gives it to anything that takes it: no Intake needed
Line Posts carry it over distance: use Power Lines on one post's insulator, then another's, to hang a span. One Power Line for every four blocks, up to 16 for copper and 32 for brass
Posts stack into a pole of any height. Use a Line Post on the side of the top one to add a branch with its own insulator
A pole joins the cables tied to it that share a colour, so lines of different colours can share poles. Brass feeds copper of its colour there, never the other way
A Breaker cuts the power, with its lever or a redstone signal. Wrench a brass wire's joint with a copper one of the same colour at a Breaker, and brass feeds copper through it
Dye Power Lines before you place them, eight around a dye: a dyed line is a slightly thicker covered cable. Two colours never join (plain is one), so cables can run side by side
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.power_network: Everything a Power Line reaches is one network. Lines on a generator's sides are one network too, brass and copper alike: it powers them all
Engineer's Goggles on a generator, a machine or a wire show the whole network: what its generators make, and what its machines use
Short of power, every machine gets an even share, as if they were wired up by hand
A Power Splitter goes on a junction of three or four ways, on a floor, wall or ceiling. Wrench it to open its screen
Set each branch First, Second or Last: when power runs short, the First branches are served before the rest. Its dial points at the First branch
To take a cable through a wall, run it up to a solid block on each side, in the same tier and colour, and wrench one end: it drills through and joins the two
A network keeps going with nobody nearby: far generators run on paper, their chunks never load, and their power still arrives
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.lava_generato: The Lava Generator: a little lava-fired turbine that makes Forge Energy
Lava goes in at the middle of its back, by pipe or by the bucket
It burns 20 mB a second, flat out whenever it has lava, and its turbine wheel spins behind the window
Power comes out of the terminals in the middle of each side: 1,024 FE a tick, enough for an Electric Motor at 16,384 SU
Power Lines take its power anywhere, even from far off while its chunk isn't loaded. What its store can't hold is lost, so give it something to power
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.electric_moto: The Electric Motor turns Forge Energy into rotation, with up to 294,912 stress units: a full steam boiler's worth
Power goes in through its base, the flange opposite the shaft: here, straight from a Lava Generator
Right-click it with a Wrench to set its speed, its stress and which way it turns
Speed snaps to Create's standard speeds. Stress snaps to what the generators make, so it's easy to match a motor to its supply
The more stress it's set to give, the more power it draws: 1 FE a tick for every 16 SU
Short of power, it stops, and starts again once it has a good reserve stored
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.geothermal_tu: The Geothermal Turbine is a 3x3x3 machine. Start with a layer of Geothermal Casings...
...with the Turbine Core in the very middle...
The Controller goes in the middle of the front, facing you
Within a second it forms into one big machine
Lava, water and power connect only through the ports under its base: pipe lava and water in from below. The gauges on the front show how much it has of each
Lava boils the water to steam that turns the turbine: 46,080 FE a tick, ten times as much from each bucket of lava as a Lava Generator
It powers anything under its base, or energy cables at the ports there: enough for two and a half Electric Motors flat out
At full power it uses 90 mB of lava and 250 mB of water a second: two fully upgraded Lava Wellsprings keep it going. Turn it down with a wrench on the controller to use less
block.comedymonkeysaddons.auto_harvester: A sealed _planter_ that grows a crop or tree and harvests it again and again. The plant itself is _never used up_.
Use a _seed_, _crop_ or _sapling_ on it to plant it. Empty-handed, use takes the harvest out and _sneak_-use takes the plant back.

Needs a _shaft_ into its _back_ (the window faces you when placed). It always uses the same stress (_512 SU_ by default) and runs _no faster_ for more speed: enchant it with _Bountiful_ to grow faster.
Holds nine stacks of harvest, taken out by _hoppers_, _chutes_, _funnels_, pipes or arms from any side. When full it _stops_ and puts _no stress_ on the network.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.cuckoo_clock.t: A Black Forest _wall clock_, two blocks tall, that keeps the village to _set restock times_.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot.tex: Trade Bot comes docked in his winding station: place them as one. He's yours, and only you and your team can give him jobs
Feed Forge Energy in from underneath, through a cable or a generator that outputs upward. The station stores 100,000 FE
While he's docked it winds him up, 64 FE a tick. A full charge of 100,000 FE carries him around 25,000 blocks
A redstone signal keeps him at home
A comparator reads 5 while he's home, 10 while he's out working, and 15 when he needs you: low on charge, or run down
Engineer's Goggles on the station show his charge, what he's doing, his containers and today's trades
Sneak-click the station with a Wrench to pack him back into one item, jobs and all. Nothing else can break it
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot_lin: Right-click his station for its screen: his charge, his containers, and buttons to Select containers or Call him home
Select containers, then right-click containers out in the world. The first click makes one an input, that he takes goods from
Click one again to make it his output, if he hasn't got one yet
He takes up to 4 inputs and 1 output, within 64 blocks. Left-click one to unlink it; sneak, or click his station, when you're done. A belt can only be an output
His output only ever gets his earnings: emeralds, and Nuggets of Experience for the trades' XP. Whatever doesn't sell goes back where it came from
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.trade_bot_tra: He sells to villagers sitting on Create Seats, and to wandering traders: any that buy what's in his inputs, within 64 blocks of his station
When there's a sale to make he sets off by himself, by day, taking only what they'll buy
He trades from two blocks away, across the villager's workstation
In one go he makes every trade he can pay for, at the villager's real prices and stock. Each trade makes him a better price next time
Villagers earn XP and level up as usual, and any new trades that opens up he sells on the same trip
Then he delivers his emeralds, and Nuggets of Experience for the trades' XP, puts back what didn't sell, and docks
Hostile mobs frighten him, and with no health left he winds down. He never dies: wind him back up with a Wrench
The Cuckoo Clock hangs on a wall, two blocks tall: the clock, with its pendulum and weights below
Its shaft goes into the middle of its back, usually through the wall. It always uses 1,024 SU by default, about a 16-sail windmill
The hands keep the game's time, and the window shows the sun and moon crossing the sky
While it turns, villagers within 64 blocks (by default) restock at 8:00 and 12:00, on their next trip to their workstation
As the hour comes round it chimes, a carved villager rolls out with a workstation from nearby, and the cuckoo calls the hour
Engineer's Goggles show the time, when the next restock is, and how many villagers it reaches

On an _Animal Pen_: it moves in. On the ground: the animal is let out and you get the Capture Bottle back.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.animal_pen.too: Keeps _one captured animal_ and breeds it up: their drops, wool, eggs and milk without a mob farm.

Use a _Bottled Animal_ on it, then put its _breeding food_ in (by hand or funnel). With a _shaft_ turning in the _back_, every _five minutes_ each adult eats one food and has a baby; babies _grow up_ in twenty minutes, as in vanilla. Up to _128_.

Use a _sword_ to take _half the adults_ (rounded, never the last) and their drops; Looting and Fire Aspect count. _Shears_ shear every adult sheep; a _bucket_ takes milk. The _young_ are left to grow up. _Deployers_ can do all of it.
While it turns, chickens lay eggs, sheep regrow wool and cows make milk for pipes. It always uses the same stress (_256 SU_ by default), at any speed.
Opens its screen: take the animal back out (the rest are butchered into its output), and see its food, milk and what it has made.
block.comedymonkeysaddons.brass_animal_p: An _Animal Pen_ for _512_ animals, with twice the room for what they make.

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.auto_harveste: The Auto Harvester grows a crop or a sapling behind its glass, and harvests it again and again
Use a seed, crop or sapling on it to plant it. The plant itself is never used up
Turn a shaft in its back. It always uses 512 SU, and more speed won't make it any faster
Once the plant has grown, the reel sweeps across it and the harvest goes inside
Hoppers, chutes, funnels and pipes take the harvest out of any side
Saplings grow into trees that a saw fells: their logs, and a few saplings, sticks and apples
Faster-growing plants harvest more often. To speed it up, enchant it with Bountiful, from a Librarian
A Wrench opens its screen: the plant, the harvest and how far it has grown
The Monster Cage keeps one jarred monster, and brings in more of the same kind
Catch a monster in an Iron Jar, at any health
Then use the full jar on the cage to put the monster in
Feed it Monster Chow, mixed from Wheat Flour, Cinder Flour and Bone Meal, by hand or with a funnel
With a shaft turning in its back, another arrives every 20 seconds at 64 RPM, sooner the faster it turns. Each one eats chow
A sword culls half of them for their real drops, and Looting and Fire Aspect count. One is always left
Deployers can cull with a sword and catch with jars too, and funnels take the drops out
A Wrench opens its screen. Taking the jar out there empties the cage, and the rest go into its output

comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.flooded_monst: A Flooded Monster Cage holds drowned, and the Flooded Brass one guardians and elder guardians too

A zombie put in one drowns, and becomes a drowned
Now and then a drowned comes armed, and throws its trident out of the front at you. Cull the armed ones first, or stand behind it
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.netherite_mon: The Netherite Monster Cage holds Withers, caught in a Netherite Jar
It needs FE on any side but the back: 2,048 FE/t holds the Withers in a containment field, and more brings new ones in
With the shaft turning, new Withers arrive, each one eating 64 Monster Chow. Cull them for Nether Stars
If the power fails, everyone nearby gets 5 minutes of warning. Then one Wither breaks out, and another every game day until the power is back
It's blast-proof, only its owner can open or break it, and never while the field is down
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.fish_tank.tex: The Fish Tank keeps one fish, squid or axolotl, and breeds a whole school from it
Catch one with a Capture Bottle, then use the bottle on the tank
Pipe water in on any side but the back, or pour in water buckets, and feed it Fish Food, mixed from Wheat Flour, Dried Kelp and Bone Meal
With a shaft turning in its back, every five minutes at 64 RPM each adult eats one Fish Food and has young, using 250 mB of water. It holds up to 128
A sword culls half for their drops, and a water bucket scoops one out alive. One is always left. Deployers can do both
Axolotls' young grow up in twenty minutes, and one in 1,200 is born blue. A water bucket scoops the blue ones first
A tank of glow squid gives off light
A Wrench opens its screen. The Brass Fish Tank holds 512, and Fruitful, from a Librarian, makes either faster

Catch one by using a Capture Bottle on it
Then use the Bottled Animal on the pen to move it in
Put its breeding food in the trough, by hand or with a funnel
With a shaft turning in its back, every five minutes each adult eats one food and has a baby
Babies grow up in twenty minutes, as in vanilla, and then breed too. It holds up to 128 animals
A sword takes half the adults with their drops, and Looting counts. One is always left, and the young are left to grow up
Shears take every adult sheep's wool, a bucket milks cows and goats, and chickens lay eggs by themselves
Deployers can use swords, shears and buckets on it too, for a farm that runs itself
A Wrench opens its screen. Taking the bottle out there empties the pen, and the rest go into its output
Fruitful, from a Librarian, makes it breed and grow faster. The Brass Animal Pen holds 512

A machine on a connector runs from it, as from a generator
Broken or picked up, a Battery keeps its charge
comedymonkeysaddons.ponder.industrial_ba: Fill a 3x3 footprint, 3 to 9 high, with Batteries and they become one Industrial Battery: 20 million FE a block
It faces the way of the Battery that completed it. Its level column rises and falls with its charge

block.comedymonkeysaddons.brass_monster_: A _Monster Cage_ for _256_, that also takes _Nether_, _End_ and _rare_ monsters (evokers, shulkers, ravagers).

Everyone nearby gets _5 minutes_ of warning, then _one Wither breaks out_, and another every game day until the power is back. The countdown stops while nobody is near.
